summary.priceSource: Synthetic / Legacy Seed Data (457 records at ₹2,999)

sameImageBug.cause: Shared stock Unsplash URL photo-1511707171634-5f897ff02aa9 with dummy query string params (&idx=N) reused across hundreds of products in masterCatalogData.js and seed.js

price2999Bug.cause: 457 out of 1181 MarketplaceProduct MongoDB documents store hardcoded fallback price currentPrice: 2999. In product.controller.js, minPrice is calculated via Math.min(...prices), picking ₹2,999 over any real or secondary offer.

legacyCatalogExposure.cause: product.controller.js issues Product.find(filter) directly against MongoDB without any source or verification filter (e.g. source = 'live_verified'). Thus all 867 synthetic legacy products are served directly to the frontend.

serpApiStatus.environmentLoading: Resolved in Phase 5A.3.2 via explicit path configuration in env.js
serpApiStatus.blocker: Valid SerpAPI account key required to perform live HTTP ingestion.

recommendedFixOrder: 1. Obtain and configure valid live SerpAPI API key in server/.env
2. Establish separate live verified catalog collection or add source = 'live_verified' filter
3. Quarantine 867 legacy synthetic products from user-facing API routes
4. Enforce strict per-product SKU/ASIN identity schema
5. Populate exact Level-6 official manufacturer/API images and purge Unsplash/generic URLs
6. Enforce runtime image deduplication guard on category listings
7. Replace synthetic 2999 prices with verified live offer prices
8. Replace search/generated URLs with direct verified product URLs
9. Connect frontend exclusively to live-verified product endpoints
10. Execute pilot ingestion and verify invariants before full catalog rollout
